_comment: Self-timed double tail (flow.comp.sim TOPOLOGIES) in standard-cell rows, top row first, each row mirrored about the centre: input pair and tail, preamp resets, the PMOS latch stack (outer-on, cross), the NMOS latch (outer and inner init, cross-coupled pair split cross-quad over two rows), standard-cell output stage. Netlist (per PDK): written by flow.comp.subckt (double_tail_self_timed, standard-cell output stage); the cross-coupled init pair is split into halves for a cross-quad over two rows.
